exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Lie flat on a bench and grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width. Lower the bar to your chest, then press it back up to full extension.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Set the bench to a 30–45° incline and press the barbell from upper chest to full extension. Keep your feet flat and back against the pad.

exercises.name: Decline Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Secure your legs on a decline bench and press the barbell from lower chest to full extension. Focus on squeezing the lower chest at the top.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Fly
exercises.instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells above your chest with a slight elbow bend. Lower them in a wide arc and bring them back together at the top.

exercises.name: Cable Crossover
exercises.instructions: Stand between two high cable pulleys and pull the handles down and together in front of your chest. Squeeze at the centre and return slowly.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.instructions: Start in a high plank with hands shoulder-width apart. Lower your chest to the floor, then push back up while keeping your core tight.

exercises.name: Chest Dip
exercises.instructions: Grip parallel bars and lean slightly forward. Lower yourself until your elbows reach 90°, then press back up to full extension.

exercises.name: Pec Deck
exercises.instructions: Sit at the pec deck machine and place your forearms on the pads. Bring the pads together in front of your chest, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and grip the barbell just outside your legs. Drive through your heels to lift the bar, keeping your back flat throughout.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
exercises.instructions: Hinge at the hips with a flat back and pull the barbell to your lower chest. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip and pull your chin above the bar. Lower yourself fully before the next rep.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: Sit at the lat pulldown machine and pull the bar to your upper chest. Control the weight on the way back up.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.instructions: Sit upright at a cable row station and pull the handle to your abdomen. Keep your torso still and squeeze your back at the end of each rep.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.instructions: Place one knee and hand on a bench for support. Pull the dumbbell to your hip, keeping your elbow close to your body.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row
exercises.instructions: Straddle the T-bar and pull the weight to your chest with a neutral grip. Keep your back flat and drive your elbows back.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.instructions: Set a cable at head height and pull the rope attachment toward your face, flaring your elbows out. Squeeze your rear delts at the end of the movement.

exercises.name: Squat
exercises.instructions: Place the barbell on your upper traps and squat until your thighs are parallel to the floor. Drive through your heels to stand back up.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Hold the barbell at hip height and hinge forward, lowering it along your legs until you feel a hamstring stretch. Return to standing by driving your hips forward.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.instructions: Sit in the leg press machine and push the platform away until your legs are nearly straight. Lower it back until your knees reach 90°.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.instructions: Lie face-down on the leg curl machine and curl the pad toward your glutes. Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.instructions: Sit in the leg extension machine and extend your legs to full lockout. Lower the weight slowly back to the start position.

exercises.name: Lunges
exercises.instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and step forward, lowering your back knee toward the floor. Push off your front foot to return to standing.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.instructions: Rest your rear foot on a bench and hold dumbbells at your sides. Lower your front knee until your thigh is parallel to the floor, then drive back up.

exercises.name: Calf Raise
exercises.instructions: Stand on the calf raise machine with the balls of your feet on the platform. Rise onto your toes as high as possible, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.instructions: Position yourself in the hack squat machine with your back flat against the pad. Lower until your thighs are parallel, then press back up.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Stand with a wide stance and grip the bar inside your legs. Keep your chest up and drive through your heels to lift the bar to hip height.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.instructions: Stand with the barbell at shoulder height and press it overhead to full extension. Lower it back to your shoulders under control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.instructions: Sit or stand holding dumbbells at shoulder height and press them overhead until your arms are fully extended. Lower back to the start.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and raise them out to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend. Lower slowly back to your sides.

exercises.name: Front Raise
exercises.instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of your thighs and raise them forward to shoulder height. Lower under control and repeat.

exercises.name: Reverse Fly
exercises.instructions: Hinge forward at the hips and raise the dumbbells out to the sides until they reach shoulder height. Squeeze your rear delts at the top.

exercises.name: Arnold Press
exercises.instructions: Start with dumbbells in front of your face, palms facing you. Rotate your palms outward as you press overhead, then reverse on the way down.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip and curl it to shoulder height. Lower slowly back to the start.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and curl them alternately or together to shoulder height. Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.instructions: Hold dumbbells with a neutral (hammer) grip and curl them to shoulder height. This targets the brachialis and brachioradialis.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
exercises.instructions: Rest your upper arms on the preacher pad and curl the weight up to shoulder height. Lower fully to stretch the biceps.

exercises.name: Tricep Pushdown
exercises.instructions: Stand at a high cable pulley and push the bar or rope down until your arms are fully extended. Keep your elbows tucked at your sides.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher
exercises.instructions: Lie on a bench and hold a barbell above your chest. Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead, then extend back up.

exercises.name: Overhead Tricep Extension
exercises.instructions: Hold a dumbbell overhead with both hands and lower it behind your head by bending your elbows. Extend back to the start.

exercises.name: Close Grip Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Grip the barbell with hands shoulder-width apart and press it from your chest to full extension. Keep your elbows close to your body.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head. Curl your shoulders off the floor, squeezing your abs, then lower back down.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instructions: Hold a forearm plank position with your body in a straight line from head to heels. Brace your core and hold for the desired duration.

exercises.name: Leg Raise
exercises.instructions: Lie flat on your back and raise your straight legs to 90°. Lower them slowly without letting your lower back arch off the floor.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.instructions: Kneel at a high cable pulley and crunch your elbows toward your knees. Keep your hips still and focus on contracting your abs.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.instructions: Sit with your knees bent and feet off the floor. Rotate your torso from side to side, touching the floor beside your hips each time.

exercises.name: Running
exercises.instructions: Run at a steady pace, maintaining an upright posture and relaxed arm swing. Adjust speed and duration to match your fitness level.

exercises.name: Cycling
exercises.instructions: Pedal at a consistent cadence on a stationary bike. Adjust resistance to increase intensity as your fitness improves.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine
exercises.instructions: Drive with your legs first, then lean back and pull the handle to your lower chest. Reverse the sequence to return to the start.

exercises.name: Jump Rope
exercises.instructions: Jump with both feet as the rope passes under them. Keep a light bounce and use your wrists to rotate the rope.

exercises.name: Stair Climber
exercises.instructions: Step at a steady pace on the stair climber, keeping your torso upright. Avoid leaning heavily on the handrails.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.instructions: Rest your upper back on a bench with a barbell across your hips. Drive your hips up until your body forms a straight line, then lower back down.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. Push your hips toward the ceiling, squeezing your glutes at the top, then lower back down.

exercises.name: Cable Kickback
exercises.instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable and kick your leg back until your glute is fully contracted. Return slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: Donkey Kick
exercises.instructions: Start on all fours and kick one leg back and up, keeping the knee bent at 90°. Squeeze your glute at the top and lower back to start.

exercises.name: Step Up
exercises.instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and step onto a box or bench with one foot. Drive through your heel to bring your other foot up, then step back down.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.instructions: Sit at the machine and grip the handles at chest height. Press forward until arms are extended, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Lie on the bench and press the bar upward in a fixed path. Lower to chest level and repeat.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-Up
exercises.instructions: Use the assisted pull-up machine to reduce body weight. Pull your chin above the bar and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
exercises.instructions: Hang from a bar with an underhand grip and pull your chin above the bar. Lower yourself fully.

exercises.name: Machine Row
exercises.instructions: Sit at the machine and pull the handles toward your body. Squeeze your back and return slowly.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.instructions: Hold a dumbbell at chest height and squat until thighs are parallel to the floor. Drive through heels to stand.

exercises.name: Sissy Squat
exercises.instructions: Hold onto a support and lean back while bending your knees. Lower your body until thighs are nearly parallel.

exercises.name: Pendulum Squat
exercises.instructions: Sit in the pendulum machine and push the platform away. Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: Leg Abduction
exercises.instructions: Sit at the machine and push your legs outward against resistance. Return slowly to start.

exercises.name: Leg Adduction
exercises.instructions: Sit at the machine and pull your legs together against resistance. Return slowly to start.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.instructions: Sit at the machine and press the handles upward. Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: Shrug
exercises.instructions: Hold a barbell at hip height and shrug your shoulders up toward your ears. Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shrug
exercises.instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and shrug your shoulders up. Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: Cable Curl
exercises.instructions: Stand at a cable machine and curl the bar toward your shoulders. Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Machine Curl
exercises.instructions: Sit at the machine and curl the handles toward you. Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: Dips
exercises.instructions: Grip parallel bars and lower your body until elbows reach 90°. Press back up to full extension.

exercises.name: Assisted Dips
exercises.instructions: Use the assisted dips machine to reduce body weight. Lower until elbows reach 90° and press back up.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.instructions: Hang from a bar and raise your legs to 90°. Lower slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.instructions: Kneel and roll the ab wheel forward, extending your body. Roll back to start.

exercises.name: Decline Sit-Up
exercises.instructions: Sit on a decline bench and perform a sit-up. Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: Elliptical Machine
exercises.instructions: Step onto the elliptical and maintain a steady pace. Adjust resistance as needed.

exercises.name: Treadmill
exercises.instructions: Run or walk on the treadmill at your desired pace. Adjust incline for added difficulty.

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.instructions: Start standing, drop to a plank, do a push-up, jump your feet back, and jump up.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.instructions: Start in a plank position and alternate bringing your knees toward your chest rapidly.

exercises.name: Leg Press (Glute Focus)
exercises.instructions: Position feet high on the platform and press away. Lower slowly to emphasize glutes.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Squat
exercises.instructions: Position yourself under the bar and squat until thighs are parallel. Press back up.

exercises.name: Banded Glute Bridge
exercises.instructions: Place a resistance band around your thighs and perform a glute bridge. Squeeze at the top.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
exercises.instructions: Hold a kettlebell with both hands and swing it from hip to shoulder height. Drive with your hips.

exercises.name: Battle Ropes
exercises.instructions: Hold both ends of the rope and create waves by moving your arms up and down alternately.

exercises.name: Sled Push
exercises.instructions: Push the sled forward with your legs, maintaining an upright posture. Return to start.

exercises.name: Sled Pull
exercises.instructions: Pull the sled toward you using your legs and back. Maintain good posture throughout.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.instructions: Jump onto a box from a standing position. Step down and repeat.

exercises.name: Tire Flip
exercises.instructions: Grip the tire and flip it end over end. Maintain explosive power throughout.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
exercises.instructions: Hold heavy dumbbells at your sides and walk forward. Maintain upright posture.

exercises.name: Landmine Press
exercises.instructions: Hold the end of a barbell in a landmine and press upward at an angle.

exercises.name: Landmine Row
exercises.instructions: Hold the end of a barbell in a landmine and row it toward your chest.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Stand inside the trap bar and lift it to hip height. Keep your back flat throughout.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Chest Press
exercises.instructions: Anchor a resistance band and press forward against the resistance. Return to start.

exercises.name: Plate-Loaded Chest Press
exercises.instructions: Load plates onto the machine and press forward. Maintain control throughout.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press
exercises.instructions: Press dumbbells together while pressing upward. Squeeze at the top of the movement.

exercises.name: Isometric Chest Hold
exercises.instructions: Hold dumbbells or a barbell at chest level without moving. Hold for time.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
exercises.instructions: On an incline bench, perform a fly motion with dumbbells. Focus on chest contraction.

exercises.name: Seal Row
exercises.instructions: Lie on an incline bench and row the barbell to your chest. Isolate the back muscles.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.instructions: Hang under a bar and pull your chest to the bar. Keep your body straight.

exercises.name: Pendulum Row
exercises.instructions: Load the pendulum machine and row the handles toward you. Maintain control.

exercises.name: Reverse Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: Use an underhand grip on the lat pulldown and pull to your upper chest.

exercises.name: V-Squat
exercises.instructions: Use the V-squat machine to perform a squat with a V-shaped path.

exercises.name: Pike Push-Up
exercises.instructions: Start in downward dog position and lower your head toward the ground.

exercises.name: Upright Row
exercises.instructions: Hold a barbell and pull it up to shoulder height, elbows high.

exercises.name: Swimming
exercises.instructions: Swim laps at a steady pace. Use different strokes for variety.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
exercises.instructions: Use the Smith machine for a hip thrust. Drive hips up to full extension.

exercises.name: Banded Hip Thrust
exercises.instructions: Place a resistance band around your hips and thrust upward.

exercises.name: Glute Kickback
exercises.instructions: Use the glute kickback machine to extend your leg backward.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
exercises.instructions: Stand facing away from a cable machine and pull the rope through your legs.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
exercises.instructions: Perform a hip thrust with one leg extended. Alternate legs.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.instructions: Squat down, jump back to plank, do a push-up, jump back, and jump up.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
exercises.instructions: In a plank position, alternate bringing knees toward chest rapidly.

exercises.name: Medicine Ball Slam
exercises.instructions: Hold a medicine ball overhead and slam it to the ground with force.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Snatch
exercises.instructions: Explosively pull a dumbbell from the ground to overhead in one motion.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Clean
exercises.instructions: Pull a dumbbell from the ground to shoulder height explosively.

exercises.name: Barbell Snatch
exercises.instructions: Explosively pull a barbell from the ground to overhead in one motion.

exercises.name: Barbell Clean
exercises.instructions: Pull a barbell from the ground to shoulder height explosively.

exercises.name: Barbell Jerk
exercises.instructions: From shoulder height, explosively press a barbell overhead.

exercises.name: Power Clean
exercises.instructions: Perform a clean with explosive power from the ground.

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.instructions: Hold a barbell at shoulder height and squat down. Keep chest up.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.instructions: Place barbell on upper back and squat down. Drive through heels.

exercises.name: Incline Treadmill Walk
exercises.instructions: Walk on a treadmill at a high incline. Great for glute activation.

exercises.name: Sled Drag
exercises.instructions: Drag a sled backward using a rope. Maintain steady pace.

exercises.name: Prowler Push
exercises.instructions: Push a prowler sled forward using your legs. Maintain low body position.

exercises.name: Reverse Sled Drag
exercises.instructions: Drag a sled forward facing backward. Great for posterior chain.

exercises.name: Sled Leg Press
exercises.instructions: Push a sled using your legs from a seated position.

exercises.name: Rope Climb
exercises.instructions: Climb a rope using your arms and legs. Maintain control.

exercises.name: Wall Ball
exercises.instructions: Squat and throw a medicine ball at a wall. Catch and repeat.

exercises.name: Sled Sprint
exercises.instructions: Sprint while pushing a sled. Explosive power and speed.
